items.mainDefect: The truthiness fallback treats an explicit max_processes=0 as missing.

secondary.defect: An empty shard assignment creates zero flusher processes, leaving flushing and submit/join processing inactive.

items.mainDefect: Collecting full-cluster memory information from every buffer performs redundant Redis INFO round-trips on the hot submit path.

secondary.defect: Aggregating the repeated full-cluster memory maps multiplies reported used and available memory by the number of flusher processes.

items.mainDefect: The test relies on a mocked, no-op sleep to wait for flushing, making its assertion racy.

secondary.defect: The same sleep mock removes the flusher loop's delay, causing a tight busy-loop.
